title: powdog spot catalogue
description: Shared spots, the same for every user. Personal data (home base, drive times, favourites) never goes here; it lives in D1 (ADR 0009).

id.description: Stable key, lowercase with hyphens; never reused.

range.description: Mountain range, as riders name it.

topElevationM.description: Highest rideable point, metres above sea level; forecasts are taken here.

baseElevationM.description: Bottom of the riding, metres above sea level.

lifts.description: Lift-served riding exists (lift mode only scores spots with lifts).

avalanche.description: EAWS bulletin for this spot, or null where no bulletin exists (ADR 0004).

feed.description: The feed file name, e.g. CZ, SK, PL-12, AT-04.

region.description: The micro-region ID inside the feed, e.g. CZ-04, AT-04-01.

dogs.description: Dog rules for the riding area (national parks differ).

verify.description: Fields whose values still need checking against a primary source.
